items.title: Einspruch deadline against Kindergeld decision
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Thu 19.11.2026. The letter itself states delivery occurs on the 4th day after posting ("am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post"). Counting: 19.11 (+1)=20.11 Fri, (+2)=21.11 Sat, (+3)=22.11 Sun, (+4)=23.11 Mon -> deemed delivery = Mon 23.11.2026. Kindergeld decisions of the Familienkasse follow the tax-office rule (§108 Abs.3 AO analog): since 23.11.2026 is a Monday (working day), no shift needed, delivery stands at 23.11.2026. One-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO counting rule, §108 Abs.1 AO / §187 ff. BGB): day of delivery not counted, period runs from 24.11.2026 and ends one month later on the same-numbered day, i.e. 23.12.2026. Checked: 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend day or public holiday in NW, so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.

items.title: Submit new Studienbescheinigung (enrollment certificate)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie uns zum Ende des Sommersemesters eine neue Studienbescheinigung ein.
items.computation: The letter requires a new certificate of enrollment 'zum Ende des Sommersemesters' (by the end of the summer semester) but does not state which year's summer semester is meant. Clara's studies began in Wintersemester 2026/27 (Oct 2026–Mar 2027); the next following Sommersemester is SS 2027, which at German universities conventionally runs to 30 September. Taking the most plausible reading, the deadline is the end of Sommersemester 2027, i.e. 30.09.2027. This is an assumption, not a date stated numerically in the letter, so confidence is lowered.
